Sam (sam_cs): Heads up — Horizon Ads just pinged about adding 3 new teams (Growth, ML Infra, Data Science). They say ads-ranking and semantic search pilots will start next quarter.
Nina (nina_ae): Nice. Renewal for them in ~90 days, right? Could be upsell if we show capacity.
Sam (sam_cs): Correct — renewal window in June. Also they reported a big spike in embeddings: last 7d embeddings units up ~10x, tokens/day up ~2x. They asked about dedicated pods / reserved capacity.
Kevin (kevin_eng): Can you share the usage curve and current p95 latency? Need to verify they won't blow SLOs.
Sam (sam_cs): Sending quick metrics: ```
7d embeddings: 980k units (prev 95k)
Tokens/day peak: 1.2M -> 2.4M
p95 gen latency: 210ms
Current reserved: none
```
Lucy (lucy_onboard): We have 2 onboarding cohorts next week. If they need enablement for multiple teams, we can add a 60-min deep-dive slot Thurs 11am PT.
Nina (nina_ae): Lock that slot if possible. I'll propose Thurs in the account exec thread and include pricing for Dedicated capacity options.
Jordi (jordi_support): I'll prepare runbook snippets for their infra folks (KV cache, batching config) — will drop links.
Sam (sam_cs): Also capture feedback: they want better examples for streaming and partial-output handling — said our docs are good but missing ad-ranking examples.
ops-bot: Ticket created: CS-4821 — "Horizon Ads expansion: embed spike + dedicated options" <https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4821>
Nina (nina_ae): I'll sync with sales engineering and loop in product for ad-ranking examples. @kevin_eng can you estimate infra uplift for a reserved pool to handle 3 teams?
Kevin (kevin_eng): Quick estimate: 1-2 A100 equiv nodes should cover steady-state, with autoscale for peaks. I'll put numbers in the ticket.
Sam (sam_cs): Great — tracking action items in CS-4821. Will follow up after Thurs deep-dive. :thumbsup:
